max-cps.name: Max CPS
max-cps.description: Highest clicks per second the generated macro may use. 240 physics frames per second, so 15 cps means presses are at least 16 frames apart.

min-hold.name: Minimum click length
min-hold.description: Shortest press, in frames. 1 solves the most levels; raise it if your bot drops very short clicks.

harden-timings.name: Harden timings
harden-timings.description: Spend a few extra seconds making the macro survive a frame of timing slop. Strongly recommended if you use Click Between Frames.
